title: Agent Verifiers in Counterfactual Analysis: A Pilot Study Benchmarking Agentic Heterogeneous Treatment Effects
abstract: arXiv:2611.23621v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents can expand the covariate space of randomized experiments by retrieving fast-moving local context missed by slow-changing survey baseline covariates, helping characterize who benefits most from an intervention. Verifying such covariates is difficult: individual treatment effects are unobserved, retrieval leakage can pull post-treatment information into nominally pretreatment summaries, and encoder leakage can inject post-treatment pretraining knowledge into representations even after temporal filtering of inputs. Guided by a two-channel information bound separating summary provenance from encoder weights, we propose a three-layer benchmark protocol: (i) retrieval admissibility via pre-treatment date filtering; (ii) heterogeneity validation scored rank-weighted average treatment effects (RATEs); and (iii) encoder admissibility checked with chronologically vintaged encoders, future-fact probes, and weight perturbations. translated_title: 反事实分析中的智能体验证器：智能体化异质性处理效应基准测试的试点研究
translated_abstract: 智能体可以通过检索快速变化的局部上下文（这些信息往往被变化缓慢的问卷调查基线协变量所遗漏）来扩展随机实验的协变量空间，从而帮助刻画哪些人群最能从某项干预中受益。然而验证这类协变量十分困难：个体处理效应本身不可观测；检索泄露可能将处理后信息混入名义上的处理前摘要；而编码器泄露即使在输入经过时间过滤后，仍可能通过预训练知识将处理后信息注入到表示之中。在一个区分摘要来源与编码器权重的双通道信息界限的指导下，我们提出了一个三层基准测试协议：(i) 通过处理前日期过滤实现检索可采性检验；(ii) 以排序加权平均处理效应（RATE）为评分标准的异质性验证；(iii) 借助按时间分版本的编码器、未来事实探针和权重扰动来检验编码器可采性。在11个数据（集）上的实验……
tldr: 本文提出一个包含检索可采性、基于RATE的异质性验证和编码器可采性检验的三层基准协议，用于防范检索泄露与编码器泄露，从而可靠地评估智能体在异质性处理效应估计中的表现。
en_tdlr: We propose a three-layer benchmark protocol—retrieval admissibility via pre-treatment date filtering, heterogeneity validation via RATEs, and encoder admissibility via vintaged encoders, future-fact probes, and weight perturbations—to guard against retrieval and encoder leakage when benchmarking agentic heterogeneous treatment effects.
